description: Standardized glossary of approved Akan names, kinship terms, and cultural concepts for the Twi Translation Benchmark Lab.

terms.Ama: Akan female day-name for Saturday-born girl; main protagonist
terms.Kofi: Akan male day-name for Friday-born boy
terms.Abena: Akan female day-name for Tuesday-born girl
terms.Kweku: Akan male day-name for Wednesday-born boy
terms.Yaa: Akan female day-name for Thursday-born girl
terms.Esi: Akan female day-name for Sunday-born girl
terms.Adwoa: Akan female day-name for Monday-born girl
terms.Akua: Akan female day-name for Wednesday-born girl
terms.odum: Large native sacred hardwood tree (Milicia excelsa) used as community gathering point
terms.chief's palace: Ahenfie; traditional administrative seat and residence of the local ruler
terms.elders: Mpanimfoɔ; council of venerable community leaders and advisers
